business_summary: LOTTE Corporation engages in the food, retail, chemical, construction, manufacturing, tourism, service, and finance businesses worldwide. It offers confectionery, beverages, liquor, food ingredients, and processed foods; coffee and coffee mixes, powdered drinks, food and beverage solution, and petcare products; manufactures, wholesales, and distributes soft drinks and alcoholic beverages; import and sells wine; and engages in restaurant franchise business. The company also operates department stores, grocery market, supermarkets, convenience stores, and home shopping networks; e-commerce platform; easy payment service; imports and sells clothing and general merchandise; retails consumer elec payment services; and operates multiplex movie theater. In addition, it manufactures and sells petrochemicals, aluminium anode foil, organic chemical, Acetic acid, VAM, hydrogen, office machinery, electronic instruments, synthetic resins, synthetic textiles, and by-products; imports and exports cameras, medical devices, projectors, and network cameras; and offers instant cameras, photobooks, photo solution services, digital printing devices, RFID and IoT solutions, etc. Further, the company engages in housing, architecture, civil engineering, and plant; construction; delivery, distribution/storage, shipping, forwarding, port operations, and consultation activities; rental of car and equipment; operation of resort condominium, Tourist hotel, and LOTTE World Tower and Mall, as well as theme parks; construction and management of golf course; Culture and arts business; social welfare activities; education consultancy; real estate development and financial consulting; owns a professional baseball team; and offers digital platform, travel, Lease financing, corporate, and individual loans. The company was formerly known as Lotte Confectionery Co. Ltd. and changed its name to LOTTE Corporation in October 2017. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: LOTTE Corporation은 식품, 소매, 화학, 건설, 제조, 관광, 서비스, 금융 사업을 전 세계적으로 영위하고 있습니다. 제과, 음료, 주류, 식품재료, 가공식품 등을 판매하고 있습니다. 커피 및 커피 믹스, 분말 음료, 식품 및 음료 솔루션, 애완동물 관리 제품; 청량음료 및 주류를 제조, 도매, 유통합니다. 와인 수입 및 판매; 외식 프랜차이즈 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 또한 백화점, 식료품점, 슈퍼마켓, 편의점, 홈쇼핑 네트워크를 운영하고 있습니다. 전자상거래 플랫폼; 간편결제서비스; 의류 및 일반 상품을 수입 및 판매합니다. 소비자 전자 결제 서비스를 소매합니다. 멀티플렉스 영화관을 운영하고 있습니다. 또한 석유화학제품, 알루미늄 양극박, 유기화학제품, 아세트산, VAM, 수소, 사무기기, 전자기기, 합성수지, 합성섬유 및 부산물 등을 제조, 판매하고 있습니다. 카메라, 의료기기, 프로젝터, 네트워크 카메라 등을 수입 및 수출합니다. 즉석카메라, 포토북, 포토솔루션 서비스, 디지털 프린팅 기기, RFID 및 IoT 솔루션 등을 제공하고 있습니다.
